meta.title: Fix WhatsApp Tray Exit Delegation Issue

context.issue: WhatsApp tray exit closes entire process instead of just unloading WhatsApp instance
context.expected_behavior: Tray exit should only unload that specific instance and remove its tray icon
context.current_behavior: Tray exit closes the entire process even when other instances are running
context.environment: delegation scenario where multiple providers run in same process

instructions: Investigate why WhatsApp tray exit closes entire process
Analyze the quit handler logic in base.provider.js
Test the session counting mechanism during delegation
Identify the root cause of incorrect session state
Implement fix to only unload specific instance
Validate fix works in delegation scenarios
priorities: Maintain correct tray behavior per instance

REQUIRED: Follow existing code patterns and architecture
Test both isolated and delegation scenarios
